custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create 201 active parts for this test whose part numbers start with the same text, so one search lists all 201.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make the import file: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu. Click Download Template and open the file in a spreadsheet program. Add 201 rows, one per part: part_number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425596-001 to ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425596-201, name ZZAUTOTEST PL C425596 PART with the same number, quantity 1, purchase_price 10. Save it as a CSV file.
  2. Import it: On the same page click Select CSV File, pick the file, then click Submit File.
